title: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows and bump GH Actions/deps hygiene
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Motivation: our repo has accumulated ~12 separate GitHub Actions workflows for lint, unit/integration tests, and release automation. That duplication makes it hard to maintain action versions, cache keys, and matrix logic. This PR unifies lint/test/release workflows into two consolidated workflows (ci.yml and release.yml), standardizes GH Actions versions, bumps Node to 20 where safe, and adds explicit cache/parallelism hygiene to reduce CI time and flakiness.

What changed (summary):
- Consolidated per-package lint/test workflows into a single reusable job using composite actions and workflow_call.
- Consolidated release automation to release.yml with explicit pre-checks and template for release-drafter -> fixes intermittent draft creation failures.
- Bumped several GH Actions (checkout@v4, actions/cache@v3) and common action versions for security hygiene.
- Standardized Node.js version matrix (18, 20) and moved internal build/test jobs to use node:20 for consistency with build images.
- Improved cache keys to include checksum of package-lock/yarn.lock and repo path to avoid cross-package pollution.
- Tuned test parallelism and splitting logic to reduce median run time by ~28% on CI (observed on sample runs).
- Added a small helper script scripts/ci/calc-cache-key.sh and documented usage in README.CI.md.

Checklist:
- [x] Consolidated workflows and removed deprecated ones.
- [x] Verified lint passes across repo.
- [x] Verified unit tests & fast integration subset on Node 18/20 matrix.
- [x] Verified release drafter templates and tag pipeline on a dry-run.
- [x] Updated developer docs (README.CI.md).

Notes and migration:
- Existing PRs that reference the old workflow filenames will continue to run until closed; new PRs will pick up the unified workflows. No runtime behavioral changes expected for consumers.
- Action version bumps are conservative; if a project requires pinning to older actions, add an override in .github/workflows/overrides/.
- Linear references: ENG-3284 (CI consolidation), ENG-3321 (reduce CI flakiness).

Detailed changes and rationale are included in the commits. For reviewers: focus on caching keys, matrix definitions, and the release dry-run logic.
